references.text: Confirms the requirement of two or three witnesses to carry out the death penalty, the same principle regarding witnesses in capital cases.
Repeats the rule that one witness is not sufficient to convict someone of a crime; it requires two or three witnesses.
Jesus refers to the principle of two or three witnesses to establish the truth in a matter.
Paul quotes the principle that every case must be established by the word of two or three witnesses.
Refers to the Law of Moses where some die without mercy on the basis of two or three witnesses.
Applies the witness rule to accusations against elders in the church, requiring two or three witnesses.
